li.label: Nightmare Magic Crest
li.description: Nightmare Incarnation: A volatile magical power\n [PAWN_nameDef] possesses an enormous amount of magical power as a demon. [PAWN_possessive] Evil powers that are comparable to high-ranking demons are extremely difficult to control, and physical maintenance alone will require a great deal of magical power cost. It is a very dangerous and awkward predisposition even for fellows.

li.label: Corrupted Demon
li.description: Fallen Dream Magic: Aphrodisiac magic power\n [PAWN_nameDef] is a powerful demon skilled in the art of illusion spells. [PAWN_pronoun] enjoys seeing the pain in the faces of [PAWN_possessive] victims as [PAWN_pronoun] squeezes the last bit of life from them.

li.label: Last Memon
li.description: Dream of lust: Wasted magic power characteristics\n [PAWN_nameDef] is a powerfull succubus who can use [PAWN_possessive] to enthrall her victims without uttering a word. While [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't kill [PAWN_possessive] victims, [PAWN_pronoun] works tirelessly to find new victims and drain mana from them.

li.label: Mischief Crest
li.description: Foursome Dream Magic: Surprise magic power characteristics\n [PAWN_nameDef] is not as adept at illusion than other succubi, instead prefering to use mana to harm [PAWN_possessive] victims directly. [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't like to be bossed around or being told how to use [PAWN_possessive] magic. [PAWN_pronoun] revels in chaos and will try to cause as much as possible.

li.label: Charm crest
li.description: Enchanted Dream Magic: Illusion type magic power\n [PAWN_nameDef] prefers to charm and deceive [PAWN_possessive] victims instead of attacking directly. [PAWN_possessive] illusion capabilities are excellent and [PAWN_pronoun] is very adapt at collecting mana.

li.label: Serenity Magic Crest
li.description: Silence dreamer: Consumption reduction type magic power characteristics\n While [PAWN_nameDef] is a succubus, [PAWN_possessive] powers are very weak compared to other succubi. [PAWN_pronoun] uses [PAWN_possessive] powers to subtly influence [PAWN_possessive] victims to give their mana willingly.
